items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

ctx.x: But that was about the last gig I had with Thelonius.

During this period, Red Garland comes through New York. Philly Jimmy Joe Jones, myself and Red Garland played a little East Side joint, little jazz joint, up in the 90s. That place was really diggin' it, but cat wouldn't take care of business. The cat would come in at 12:00 and play until three and that was it, you know. So, that didn't last long and Archie Shepp had some more (unintelligible) gigs for me. He say, "Well, come on, Wilbur, let's go down to Philly" -- about 72 -- and coming down here to play at a…
